_comment: Cloudutsuk house style. One entry per top-level _posts/ folder. accent/accent2 drive the mesh glow, kicker, chips and motif; motif2d picks the Level-1 procedural motif (network|stack|pipeline|shield|blueprint|orbit); scene is the subject hint used by Level 2 (3D) and Level 3 (Flux) prompts.
